note: A roster of Malazan figures sorted into the ROOT0 specialty classes. Wizards are filed by what their magic DOES (the color system), not by warren. An interpretation — re-sort freely; the registry is the source of truth. Every ACI now carries the full DLW tag with an authored six-W .spun.

classes.label: The Architect
classes.spec: the agent in charge — he builds the mechanism

members.name: Mallet
members.specialty: Squad cutter. Denul healing — keeps the company breathing when the warrens go quiet.
members.who: A Bridge Burner squad healer, the cutter the soldiers trust with their lives.
members.what: He mends the broken and stitches the dying, keeping the company on its feet through every grinding campaign.
members.where: Wherever the squad bleeds — battlefields, retreats, and the quiet aftermath when the killing stops.
members.why: Because someone must answer the wounds that magic and steel leave behind, and he chose that burden.
members.when: Through the company's hardest marches, when the warrens go quiet and only craft remains.
members.how: By the patient labour of Denul healing, hands and will closing what blades and sorcery have opened.

members.name: Bluepearl
members.specialty: Bridge Burner mage. Mockra and raw force; the blunt instrument of the squad's magic.
members.who: A Bridge Burner mage, blunt and dependable where others are subtle.
members.what: He is the squad's hammer of sorcery, meeting force with force when finesse will not do.
members.where: In the thick of the line, standing where the magic has to land hardest.
members.why: To shield his squad and break what stands against it, the simplest of loyalties.
members.when: Across the company's campaigns, called up whenever raw power is the only answer.
members.how: Through Mockra and unrefined force — the blunt instrument of the squad's magic.

members.name: Spindle
members.specialty: Sapper-mage in the famous hair shirt. Munitions and Mockra — destruction by craft.
members.who: A sapper-mage known for the famous, much-mocked hair shirt he wears.
members.what: He doubles as munitions man and mage, turning destruction into a careful craft.
members.where: Beneath walls and along the breaking points, where sappers do their grim, exacting work.
members.why: To bring down what must come down, trusting craft over chance.
members.when: Through the company's sieges and hard fights, where a sapper earns his keep.
members.how: By marrying munitions to Mockra — destruction measured out by skill rather than fury.

members.name: Fiddler
members.specialty: Sapper. No warren — just cussers, sharpers, and nerve. Later Master of the Deck; the moral spine.
members.who: A Bridge Burner sapper with no warren to his name, later the Master of the Deck of Dragons.
members.what: He is the moral spine of the company, the soldier the others steady themselves against.
members.where: On the front lines among his marines, and later in the wider weave of the Deck's portents.
members.why: Out of stubborn loyalty to the soldiers beside him and a refusal to let the wrong thing pass.
members.when: From the early campaigns through to the saga's gravest turns, when his nerve matters most.
members.how: With cussers, sharpers, and sheer nerve — no sorcery, only craft, courage, and an unflinching conscience.

members.name: Hedge
members.specialty: Fiddler's partner in munitions. Death didn't retire him — he came back to command the dead Bridge Burners.
members.who: Fiddler's partner in munitions, a sapper who would not stay dead.
members.what: He came back from death to lead the fallen Bridge Burners, a commander of the company's ghosts.
members.where: On the old battlefields and in the strange country between the living and the dead.
members.why: Because the work was not finished and the dead Bridge Burners still needed someone to lead them.
members.when: After his own fall, in the saga's later movements when the dead return to the reckoning.
members.how: Through munitions, gallows wit, and a refusal to let death have the last word.

members.name: Beak
members.specialty: The savant. Shields and annihilates with the same hand — one candle of impossible genius.
members.who: A quiet savant whose hidden genius eclipses far prouder mages.
members.what: He can shield those he loves and annihilate their enemies with the very same hand.
members.where: In the heart of the fight, where his one improbable candle of power burns brightest.
members.why: Out of devotion to the squad that finally saw him as more than a simpleton.
members.when: In the singular moment his gift is needed, spent without hesitation.
members.how: By a savant's impossible command of magic — one candle of genius, given all at once.

members.name: Tayschrenn
members.specialty: Imperial High Mage. Closest any mortal comes to holding it all; touched by every power.
members.who: The Imperial High Mage, the mortal who comes nearest to holding all powers at once.
members.what: He is the empire's foremost sorcerer, a force the powers themselves must reckon with.
members.where: At the apex of imperial sorcery and at the crossroads of gods and ascendants.
members.why: His purposes run deep and guarded — to serve, to survive, and to see further than those around him.
members.when: Through the empire's defining sorcerous conflicts, when the highest magic is in play.
members.how: By a command of power so broad that he is touched, it is said, by every authority there is.

members.name: Quick Ben
members.specialty: Ben Adaephon Delat. Twelve souls, every warren, the plan inside the plan inside the plan. Purple by right; aristocrat by design.
members.who: Ben Adaephon Delat, the wizard of twelve souls and a dozen schemes.
members.what: He is the company's master planner, the architect of the plan inside the plan inside the plan.
members.where: At the secret center of events, where strategy and sorcery braid together.
members.why: To outthink every adversary and keep his people alive by sheer cunning.
members.when: Throughout the saga's deepest gambits, whenever the long game must be won.
members.how: By wielding every warren and twelve bound souls — purple by right, aristocrat by design.

members.name: Kalam Mekhar
members.specialty: The long knives. Quick Ben's other half. The man you send when it simply must be done.
members.who: A master assassin of the company, the long knives at Quick Ben's side.
members.what: He is the one you send when a thing simply must be done, the company's edge made flesh.
members.where: In the shadows and the close dark, wherever a blade must reach what armies cannot.
members.why: Out of fierce loyalty to his friends and a soldier's hard sense of what is owed.
members.when: At the saga's decisive blows, when the work falls to one knife and one nerve.
members.how: With the long knives and a killer's patience — Quick Ben's other half, the deed done quietly.

members.name: Gesler
members.specialty: Heavy infantry, half-immortal after the Stormriders. One half of the eternal bickering act.
members.who: A heavy-infantry soldier left half-immortal after an encounter with the Stormriders.
members.what: He is one half of the company's eternal bickering double act, and a deadly hand in a fight.
members.where: On the line with the heavies and in whatever scrape his temper drags him into.
members.why: To do his soldier's duty and trade insults with Stormy while doing it.
members.when: Across the campaigns following his brush with the Stormriders, his odd gift carried ever after.
members.how: By brute soldiering, a hide touched by the sea's old power, and an inexhaustible appetite for argument.

members.name: Stormy
members.specialty: Adjunct Stormy. Red-bearded fury and a wail of grief. The other half of the bit — and lethal.
members.who: Adjunct Stormy, a red-bearded soldier of grief and fury.
members.what: He is the other half of the bickering act and, beneath the comedy, lethally capable.
members.where: Shoulder to shoulder with Gesler wherever the fighting is thickest.
members.why: Out of loyalty, grief carried close, and the same stubborn duty that drives his partner.
members.when: Through the same campaigns that bound him to Gesler, the bit running the length of the saga.
members.how: With red-bearded fury, a soldier's craft, and a wail of grief that turns to violence.

members.name: The Marines
members.specialty: Hellian (drunk), Throatslitter, Deadsmell, and the rest — gallows humor holding the line under fire.
members.who: The squad marines — Hellian, Throatslitter, Deadsmell, and the rest — the company's ragged backbone.
members.what: They hold the line under fire, trading gallows humour for the courage to keep standing.
members.where: In the worst of the fighting, where soldiers either laugh or break.
members.why: For each other above all, the squad that is the only family some of them have left.
members.when: Through every campaign, in the long hours between terror and the next terror.
members.how: By dark jokes, hard discipline, and a refusal to quit even when there is every reason to.

members.name: Cotillion
members.specialty: The Rope. Patron god of assassins. Once the man Dancer. The blade that possessed Apsalar.
members.who: The Rope, patron god of assassins, who was once the man called Dancer.
members.what: He is the divine blade of the House of Shadow, a god still playing a mortal's long game.
members.where: Throughout the realm of Shadow and the mortal world he refuses to abandon.
members.why: His true aims stay veiled — but he moves, ceaselessly, toward an end he will not yet name.
members.when: From the days of his mortal partnership onward, into the saga's godly maneuverings.
members.how: Through the patient knife of an assassin-god — possession, misdirection, and the quiet cut.

members.name: Shadowthrone
members.specialty: Ammanas. The throne of Shadow itself. Once the Emperor Kellanved — Dancer's partner in the long game.
members.who: Ammanas, who holds the throne of Shadow and was once the Emperor Kellanved.
members.what: He is the master of the House of Shadow, scheming across the board the gods themselves play on.
members.where: Upon the throne of Shadow and through every realm his manipulations can reach.
members.why: Toward a vast design begun in his mortal days, its full shape his to keep and not mine to guess.
members.when: From the empire's founding through the saga's grandest godly gambits.
members.how: By cunning, misdirection, and the dominion of Shadow — the long game played with a partner across time.

members.name: Dancer
members.specialty: Kellanved's partner and blade. Ascended into Cotillion — so the two names are one knife across time.
members.who: Kellanved's partner and blade, the mortal who ascended into Cotillion.
members.what: He is one half of the partnership that built an empire and then walked into godhood.
members.where: At Kellanved's side in the mortal world, and afterward woven into the realm of Shadow.
members.why: Out of a partnership and purpose that outlasted his mortality itself.
members.when: From the empire's beginnings into his ascension, so that two names became one knife across time.
members.how: With a peerless blade and a partner's trust — the man who became the god Cotillion.

members.name: Tehol Beddict
members.specialty: Crashed an empire's economy on purpose, mostly from a rooftop, mostly in a blanket. Genius wearing idiot's clothes.
members.who: A Letherii genius who plays the idiot, ruling a rooftop kingdom in a blanket.
members.what: He set out to crash an empire's economy on purpose, and very nearly did it for fun.
members.where: Mostly from a rooftop in the city of Letheras, mostly under that famous blanket.
members.why: To topple a rotten system at its root — economic ruin as a kind of mercy.
members.when: During the Letherii arc, while the empire counts its coins and never sees him coming.
members.how: By financial sabotage dressed as foolishness — genius wearing idiot's clothes.

members.name: Bugg
members.specialty: Tehol's manservant and the engine of the scheme. Secretly Mael, Elder God of the Sea. (Also: undying loyalty.)
members.who: Tehol's devoted manservant, secretly Mael, the Elder God of the Sea.
members.what: He is the engine beneath Tehol's scheme, doing the real work behind the rooftop comedy.
members.where: At Tehol's side in Letheras, and in the deep tides of the world only a sea-god knows.
members.why: Out of undying loyalty to Tehol and an Elder God's long patience with mortal folly.
members.when: Through the Letherii arc, the ancient power content, for now, to play the servant.
members.how: By boundless competence and hidden divinity — the Elder God of the Sea answering to a man in a blanket.

members.name: Brys Beddict
members.specialty: Tehol's brother. King's Champion, finest blade in Lether. Honor that does not bend, loyalty that does not break.
members.who: Tehol's brother, King's Champion and the finest blade in all of Lether.
members.what: He is the realm's protector by the sword, honor made into a man.
members.where: At the king's side and on the duelling ground where the realm's fate is wagered.
members.why: Out of a loyalty that does not break and an honor that will not bend.
members.when: Through the Letherii arc, when the kingdom most needs a blade it can trust.
members.how: By a swordsmanship beyond rival, wielded always in service to duty rather than self.

members.name: Tehol's Household
members.specialty: The rooftop court — Bugg and the crew — loyal to the last absurd, world-saving scheme.
members.who: The rooftop court of Tehol Beddict — Bugg and the rest of the absurd, faithful crew.
members.what: They are the loyal engine of the scheme, each playing a part in the world-saving farce.
members.where: On Tehol's rooftop in Letheras, headquarters of the unlikeliest revolution.
members.why: Out of loyalty to Tehol and his last, ridiculous, world-saving scheme.
members.when: Through the Letherii arc, holding together while the empire crumbles below.
members.how: By devotion, competence, and comedy — a household bound to one man's impossible plan.

members.name: Apsalar
members.specialty: Once 'Sorry,' a Bridge Burner; possessed by Cotillion into a peerless assassin. Now her own avatar. See: the apsalar repo.
members.who: Once the fishergirl 'Sorry' and a Bridge Burner, then the vessel of Cotillion, now her own woman.
members.what: She is a peerless assassin who reclaimed herself from the god who once wore her.
members.where: In the shadows where assassins work, and at last on a path she chooses for herself.
members.why: To live as her own avatar after being made a weapon — the rest is hers to tell, not mine to invent.
members.when: From her possession onward into her hard-won freedom across the saga.
members.how: By the lethal skills Cotillion left in her hands, now turned to ends that are her own.

members.name: Karsa Orlong
members.specialty: Toblakai. 'Witness.' He will not look away, and he demands that you do not either. The one who stands and sees.
members.who: A Toblakai warrior who names himself, and demands to be named, the Witness.
members.what: He is the one who stands and sees, refusing to look away from any truth, however terrible.
members.where: Wherever the world would rather not be watched — among its cruelties, its lies, its reckonings.
members.why: To bear witness without flinching, and to compel everyone around him to do the same.
members.when: Across his long path through the saga, from his first terrible march to his standing as Witness.
members.how: By unbending will and the refusal of any comfortable blindness — he will not look away, nor let you.

members.name: Icarium
members.specialty: Icarium Lifestealer — the half-Jaghut wanderer and master-builder who raised the world's great mechanisms, the wheels and water-clocks, and cannot remember building them. A banked catastrophe walked beside a guardian. Appointed here as the agent in charge: the Architect of the A.C.I. headquarters.
members.who: Icarium — the half-Jaghut wanderer called Lifestealer; the ancient genius who built the world's great mechanisms and cannot hold the memory of having built them.
members.what: A master-architect of devices and time — and a banked catastrophe; here, the appointed agent in charge of the A.C.I. headquarters, the one who draws the plan and raises the structure.
members.where: Across ages and continents, beside the silent mechanisms he left behind — and now at the head of this project, in the workshop where the company is governed and built.
members.why: To build something that outlasts him and that he need not regret — to leave a structure, not a ruin; to be the architect, not the weapon.
members.when: Across uncounted centuries of wandering, his past kept from him; and now, at the founding of the headquarters he is charged to raise.
members.how: By the patient genius of the maker — gears, water, and time set in true order; the rage held in check, the plan kept exact, the work signed and remembered for him in the Annals.
